subject: I Got Me A Copy Just Now
author: ichienkai
body:
Gamestation, mint used copy in the bargain bin £3.99!  And it looks sweeeeet, NOW i remember this game - awesome 👍

---The Way You Are--- http://www.youtube.com/watch?v=s7_GjdJmrWQ&feature=related

subject: And the Sun is broken too. And snow slows the game down a lot.
author: SUFFUR
body:
But still you can ignor it, there is still light outside, lol. As the snow goes away the game gets faster, so it's like having a Bionic car, den nen na, but i'll live with it, got to the custom series, no on the next one after, and still having fun, fun, fun, lol.

Patience is something I taught myself, so I never know when it's going to run out?

subject: Big Surf Grove is broken
author: SUFFUR
body:
There is no Moon, just a square where it should go, so if your racin' and see a pale square in the sky, it's the moon, and does look pretty in the original, also noticed some latency with the rain on and the cars get a bit floaty, but still lovin' it.

Patience is something I taught myself, so I never know when it's going to run out?

subject: Cystal summit lake, woooooooooooooooooooooooooooooohoooooooooooo
author: SUFFUR
body:
What a race that was, I am having fun, yes I'm stopping to have a ciggy and then get on with it. My first Big Shores Race was 3 perfect laps, the AI were nowhere to be seen, unlike on a race where I just kept crashing, what was it, Palm Bay Marina, everytime i crashed took the rest with me, it was SA'WHEAT, Oh thank you all for letting this get on the backward compat list, and thank you to who ever did it, person or team or just a fan, I will find out and name names. 

Patience is something I taught myself, so I never know when it's going to run out? But I have Burnout 2 point of Impact to play, so say what you want, I'm happy.

subject: done, just crash to do
author: SUFFUR
body:
4 hours is good, but have to get all gold, have 3 missing, now crash mode and unlock da super car, but got me custom roadster, so happy.

Patience is something I taught myself, so I never know when it's going to run out?
